axis.description: `spec`: the diff does not faithfully implement the task body (missing, wrong, or unasked-for behaviour). `standards`: the code breaks a standard this repo documents.

severity.description: `warn`: a concern worth recording that does not have to be fixed before the branch lands -- judgement calls belong here. `fail`: must be fixed before merge.

file.description: Repo-relative path the finding is about. Required on `standards` findings, which are always in something. Omit it on a `spec` finding about an absence rather than inventing a plausible path.

message.description: What is wrong, in one or two sentences. On `spec`, quote the task line it is about; on `standards`, cite the documented rule.

findings.description: Every issue you found, including ones you are uncertain about or consider minor -- attach a severity rather than withholding. Return `[]` when the diff is faithful to the task and consistent with the repo's standards; that is the pass case.
